description: ROS_DOMAIN_ID mismatch: robot container auto-derives domain 1, sim script and README used domain 0; services never discovered
evidence_quote: -export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=0   # must match SVG_DOMAIN_ID of the sim script [...] +manually-started containers do NOT auto-derive the domain, so `export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=1` in every shell
ruining_rationale: Mismatch blocks discovery at startup (service waits forever, no topics), so it surfaces before any flight.

description: Empty YAML list could not override string-array params (teleop_drones/external_drones); node failed with 'parameter not initialized'; params made comma-separated strings
evidence_quote: `The parameter 'X' is not initialized` | empty YAML list can't override a typed param — `teleop_drones`/`external_drones` are comma-separated STRINGS
ruining_rationale: Fails at node start-up with an explicit error; cannot reach a flight.
fix_loc: swarm_commander.py 192+/106- (whole commit; feature commit containing the string-typed params); swarm_sim.yaml 26+/8-; swarm_real.yaml 26+/13-

description: MAVROS never connected and no odometry: Isaac timeline not playing (.env PLAY_SIM_ON_START=false) so PX4 SITL never launched; default flipped to true
evidence_quote: MAVROS `connected: false`, no odometry topics | PX4 SITL not launched: Isaac timeline not playing (`PLAY_SIM_ON_START=true`, or press Play)
ruining_rationale: Sim-only start-up condition; nothing flies until the timeline plays, so it blocks rather than ruins a session.

description: Squeeze intruder was CBF-filtered like the holders; pair-constraint gradient pushed it backwards, so it stalled/retreated at the gap instead of crossing
evidence_quote: Root cause of the reported failure (intruder turning back instead of squeezing through): only teleop drones were CBF-exempt, so an autonomous squeeze intruder was filtered like everyone else.
ruining_rationale: The demo's central behavior (intruder forces holders to yield) did not happen; crossing took ~30 s marginal vs 4.9 s after the fix.

description: Each PX4 SITL EKF origin is its spawn point; commander mixed local frames as one world frame; holders 2 m off, CBF saw phantom geometry
evidence_quote: Bag analysis of squeeze_191528 (Isaac, 3 drones) showed every drone flying its commanded geometry PERFECTLY in its own frame and wrongly in the world: each PX4 SITL's EKF origin is its spawn point
ruining_rationale: Silent: every drone looked correct in its own frame while the CBF missed a real 0.49 m near-miss and the intruder missed the gap entirely.

description: Robot container on Docker bridge network could not reach the drone's uXRCE-DDS link or Motive NatNet on the LAN: no /fmu/* or /<body>/pose topics
evidence_quote: hardware: can't reach the drone / Motive (no `/fmu/*`, no `/<body>/pose` topics) | the robot container is on the Docker **bridge** net, not your LAN. Set `robot-desktop` to `network_mode: host`
ruining_rationale: No topics at all during bring-up; blocks the session before any flight rather than ruining one in progress.
fix_files: robot/docker/docker-compose.yaml (a46f04b5: network_mode: host); experiment.md troubleshooting row (736b0564)

description: MicroXRCEAgent binary absent from the robot Docker image ('command not found'); PX4 uXRCE-DDS client had no ground agent; agent baked into Dockerfile.robot
evidence_quote: `MicroXRCEAgent: command not found` | not shipped in the image — run the published `microros/micro-ros-agent:jazzy udp4 --port 8888` host container (B2), or build `MicroXRCEAgent` from source / bake into the robot image.
ruining_rationale: Missing dependency is visible on first invocation at the bench; a workaround container existed.

description: Geofence block placed under mocap_bridge instead of swarm_commander in swarm_real.yaml; fence parameters never reached the commander, geofence inert on hardware config
evidence_quote: also move the misplaced geofence block from under mocap_bridge back under swarm_commander (it was inert on the real config)
ruining_rationale: A real-drone fence breach would not have latched the swarm-wide hold; whether a breach occurred while inert is not recorded.
fix_loc: 16+/5- (whole file diff in f6441c5f, includes new px4_vio_* params)

description: Takeoff and land worked but drone never moved to a goal: /start had been rejected (arrival_threshold_m not met or geofence latched), so goal-seeking never began
evidence_quote: takeoff & land work but the drone **won't move to a goal** | goal-seeking needs a SUCCESSFUL `/start` (takeoff/land don't). [...] "not all drones holding yet" → loosen `arrival_threshold_m` or wait; "geofence breached" → `~/reset_fence` + widen fence
ruining_rationale: Drone hovered safely but the goal-tracking test did not proceed; cost is a stalled session, not a hazard.

description: robot_interface_node read the 'interface' param then hard-coded MAVROS plugin; px4_interface never loaded, real DDS drones never subscribed to fmu/out/vehicle_odometry
evidence_quote: Previously this was hardcoded to MAVROS, so the `interface` param was silently ignored and real (DDS) drones never subscribed to out/vehicle_odometry.
ruining_rationale: Commander reports missing odometry and refuses takeoff, so it blocks at the bench before flight. Defect pre-dates the fork (present in upstream AirStack e4b499d1).

description: Provisioning script wrote bare 'param'/'microdds_client' lines into voxl-px4-start; not Linux commands, set -e aborted before the client line, client never started on boot
evidence_quote: A bare `param`/`microdds_client` is NOT a Linux command — it fails, and under `set -e` aborts the startup script BEFORE the client line, so the client never starts on boot.
ruining_rationale: Boot-time only: the drone comes up with no DDS client, which is visible at the bench before a flight.
fix_loc: 77+/7- (whole file diff in 564d43e4; shared with SwarmCBF-012/-013)

description: uXRCE-DDS client started once at boot before wlan0 had an address; start failed silently and client stayed down until started by hand; retry loop added
evidence_quote: at boot wlan0 often has no address yet, so a one-shot start fails silently and the client stays down until started by hand
ruining_rationale: Manifests as a dead client at the bench; the same commit's watchdog also covers mid-session client death (Wi-Fi drop), which would cut /fmu streams in flight.
fix_loc: 77+/7- (whole file diff in 564d43e4; shared with SwarmCBF-011/-013)

description: Watchdog installed with 'systemctl enable --now', a no-op on an already-running unit; stale watchdog kept restarting the client with the previous agent IP
evidence_quote: voxl_setup_real_drone.sh: restart watchdog instead of enable --now (stale watchdog kept resurrecting the client with the old agent IP)
ruining_rationale: Client pinned to a stale ground-PC IP yields no /fmu topics on the new ground PC; found while re-provisioning at the bench.
fix_loc: 77+/7- (whole file diff in 564d43e4; shared with SwarmCBF-011/-012)

description: CBF solver treated exempt/external rows as adjustable; half of each pairwise correction assigned to a drone that never executes it; external drones fed zero velocity
evidence_quote: Without this the solver assigns them half of every pairwise correction -- evasion that is never executed. [...] holders now yield BEFORE an RC intruder reaches the 2r barrier, not after
ruining_rationale: Under-evasion around an uncommanded intruder; whether the 2r barrier was actually breached in a run is not stated.
fix_loc: cbf_filter.py 110+/33-; swarm_commander.py 118+/14- (whole commit; also adds formation profiles); test_cbf.py 70+/0-

description: Real drone's PX4 EKF2 kept fusing magnetometer heading alongside mocap yaw ('yaw estimate error', not ready); EKF2_MAG_TYPE=5 insufficient, SYS_HAS_MAG=0 plus save/restart required
evidence_quote: QGC: **"yaw estimate error"**, won't get ready | [...] `cs_mag_hdg: True` → mag still fused — set `EKF2_MAG_TYPE=5` **and** `SYS_HAS_MAG=0`, `px4-param save`, restart voxl-px4
ruining_rationale: PX4 refuses to become ready, so it is caught pre-arm on the bench.
